rounds.report:
Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (not a Blender-equivalent reproduction).

Observed in the 24 reference samples (0-17.52 s, 1280x720, 23.976 fps, 421 frames, letterboxed black-and-white): one continuous shot, no cuts. The camera starts at a rooftop/terrace parapet looking straight down a Paris boulevard (corner buildings, a roof billboard on the left, a roof sign on the right, buses and cars on the square, a church spire at the far end on the street axis). It dollies backward, and two men appear at the image edges: Vinz (image-left, no hat, dark bomber) and Said (image-right, black beanie, leather jacket with fur collar, light trousers). At first both are turned toward the street and each other. A third man, Hubert (tall, bobble beanie, sheepskin coat, camo trousers), crosses in front of them left to right at about 2.6-4.5 s. Said turns and leans back on the railing with his right elbow on it, and Vinz turns toward the camera. From about 4 s to 13.7 s a dolly-out plus zoom-in keeps the men at roughly constant size while the background grows about 5x. Hubert crosses back right to left at about 8.5-11.8 s, occluding Said and then Vinz. Vinz paces and looks down. Hubert re-enters at image-left at about 16.8 s and faces Vinz at the end.

Geometry: boxes for the parapet (light base, dark wall band, coping, top rail with posts every 1.18 m), the street buildings with darker mansard caps, the billboard and sign panels, buses and cars. Spheres and cylinders are used for the trees and street lamps, and a cone for the spire. All appearance is grey Lambert materials with linear fog for haze. The black letterbox bars are camera-attached planes matching the reference matte, not image content.

Articulation: each man is a hierarchy of root (yaw), hips, torso (pitch and roll), neck, head (yaw and pitch), shoulders, elbows, hips and knees. Said blends from standing and facing the rail into a seated-lean pose with his elbow on the rail and one knee bent. Vinz keeps his hands in his pockets, his body and head turn on keyframes, and his legs step while he paces. Hubert has an analytic walk cycle driven by distance travelled, with his hands held at his chest.

Camera and timing: the camera has no yaw and stays on the street axis. Its position z, height, pitch and zoom magnification are monotone-cubic tracks keyed at the sample timestamps. Vertical FOV is 2*atan(tan17deg/m), with m going from 1.0 to 5.25. Camera z goes from 0.75 m to 16.1 m behind the parapet. All motion is absolute-time sampled, and the update function never accumulates state.

Inference vs observation: the estimates of magnification, distances, heights and character positions are my own, derived from image measurements at the sample times. The motion between samples (entry and exit times, walk speeds, turn timing) is interpolated. The city layout is an approximate proxy.

Feedback: none received yet (initial round).

Said's elbow is near the rail rather than exactly resting on it, and his foot-on-wall leg is approximate. Head gaze directions follow keyframes estimated from the samples. Timing between samples is interpolated and was not checked against unsampled frames: Hubert's exact entry and exit moments, walk speeds and turn timing are inferred. Scoring results are unknown, and no claim is made of equivalence to Blender results.
